exposure: mode of delivery (normal vaginal delivery, cesarean, instrumental delivery)
outcome: outcome of postpartum Acute Kidney Injury (good or bad)
cohort: Fifty patients diagnosed with Acute Kidney Injury during the postpartum period and requiring hemodialysis were included in the study.
finding: Patients with post-partum hemorrhage, gestational diabetes mellitus, or hypertension had a statistically significant increased risk of experiencing a poor outcome of acute kidney injury.
